head.text: Load-Use Hazard — worst-case 5-cycle ID stall (stage 7e: IF/ID/RR/EX1/EX2/MEM1/MEM1B/MEM2/WB)

foot.text: The load occupies six producer slots (id_rr_q..mem1_mem2_q) before the only load-forwarding path, FWD_MEMWB (mem_wb_q.alu_result, registered), becomes valid — the consumer stalls in ID for 5 cycles (kronos_hazard priority 3a: load_use stalls pc/if_id/id_rr, bubbles into RR) until then (§7). Measured at stage 7e (bench_load_use_hit, §11): 7 cycles/op end-to-end (load issue + the 5-cycle stall + the consumer's own execute), consistent with this 5-cycle stall plus the load's own 1-cycle issue and the consumer's 1-cycle resolution. The Timing Table's pre-7e figure of 3 cycles (5-stage-pipeline era) is what this re-measurement replaces.
